code_samples.title: Thresholds
code_samples.content:
# Sol Momentum DEX Ladder v1 thresholds
# Source: STRATEGY.md filter/exit tables

# --- Screener filters ---
SCREENER_MIN_MARKET_CAP_USD=500000
SCREENER_MAX_MARKET_CAP_USD=5000000
SCREENER_MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD=50000
SCREENER_MIN_VOLUME_24H_USD=0
SCREENER_MIN_PRICE_CHANGE_5M_PCT=10
SCREENER_MIN_PRICE_CHANGE_1H_PCT=50
SCREENER_MIN_BUY_SELL_RATIO=1.5
SCREENER_MIN_HOLDERS=200
SCREENER_HOLDERS_REQUIRED=false
SCREENER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=30000

# --- Spot ladder ---
SPOT_RISK_UNIT_SOL=1.0
MAX_CONCURRENT_SPOT_POSITIONS=1
LADDER_TRANCHE_A_FRAC=0.40
LADDER_TRANCHE_B_FRAC=0.35
LADDER_TRANCHE_C_FRAC=0.25
LADDER_TRANCHE_B_PULLBACK_MIN_PCT=5
LADDER_TRANCHE_B_PULLBACK_MAX_PCT=10

# --- Exit tiers ---
EXIT_TIER1_GAIN_PCT=50
EXIT_TIER1_SELL_FRAC=0.40
EXIT_TIER2_GAIN_PCT=100
EXIT_TIER2_SELL_FRAC=0.30
EXIT_TIER3_GAIN_MIN_PCT=200
EXIT_TIER3_GAIN_MAX_PCT=300
EXIT_TIER3_SELL_FRAC=0.20

# --- Hard stops ---
HARD_STOP_PCT=20
TRAILING_STOP_FRAC=0.15
LIQUIDITY_DROP_PCT=15
LIQUIDITY_DROP_WINDOW_SEC=300
TIME_STOP_FLAT_SEC=1800

# --- Jupiter ---
JUPITER_SLIPPAGE_BPS=100
JUPITER_PRIORITY_FEE_LAMPORTS=50000
JUPITER_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_SEC=60

# --- Live gate ---
SOLANA_MIN_BALANCE_SOL=0.5
GATE_LIVE_MIN_CANDIDATE_EVENTS=1

# --- Audit paths ---
SOL_MOMENTUM_CANDIDATES_NDJSON=[path redacted]
SOL_MOMENTUM_LADDER_NDJSON=[path redacted]
SOL_MOMENTUM_LADDER_STATE_PATH=[path redacted]

code_samples.title: Run wrapper
code_samples.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Wrapper: strategies/sol-momentum-dex-ladder-v1 -> canonical run script.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
exec "$ROOT/scripts/testing/run-sol-momentum-dex-ladder.sh" "$@"
